tickets.title: CLI exit code must return 0 for ARBITER_SHIP when applied
tickets.defect: cli.py line 223 returns 0 only when final_verdict == 'APPROVE'. An ARBITER_SHIP with --apply returns exit 1, which is wrong: the arbiter recommended SHIP and the human signed off with --allow-unapproved --apply. This means CI and wrapper scripts that check the exit code will treat a successful arbiter-ship as a failure.
tickets.spec: Change the exit code condition to return 0 when any result has final_verdict == 'APPROVE' OR final_verdict == 'ARBITER_SHIP'. The condition on line 223 currently reads: return 0 if any(r.get('final_verdict') == 'APPROVE' for r in results) else 1. Change it to also include ARBITER_SHIP. Keep it a single line.
